language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the plugin messages. auto: follows the Claude Code language setting, then the system locale.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto: JEV decides; off: disabled; explicit: only what is forced

effortsHaiku.title: Efforts with haiku
effortsHaiku.description: Efforts allowed with haiku (low..max). Empty disables haiku.

effortsSonnet.title: Efforts with sonnet
effortsSonnet.description: Efforts allowed with sonnet (low..max). Empty disables sonnet.

effortsOpus.title: Efforts with opus
effortsOpus.description: Efforts allowed with opus (low..max). Empty disables opus.

fallbackOrder.title: Fallback order
fallbackOrder.description: Models tried, in order, when the chosen one is disabled.

agentsIntercept.title: Intercepted agents
agentsIntercept.description: Agent types the mod rewrites; the others pass through untouched.

agentsTarget.title: Target profiles
agentsTarget.description: Profiles the mod may switch to (explore, general).

forceEffort.title: Force effort
forceEffort.description: Fixed effort for any profile. jev: JEV decides.

forceEffortExplore.title: Force effort (explore)
forceEffortExplore.description: Fixed effort for the explore profile only.

forceEffortGeneral.title: Force effort (general)
forceEffortGeneral.description: Fixed effort for the general profile only.

forceTools.title: Force tools
forceTools.description: Fixed tools (still filtered by toolsDeny and the catalog). Empty: JEV decides.

fallbackAgent.title: Fallback: agent
fallbackAgent.description: Agent type used when JEV fails.

multiModel.title: Multi-model
multiModel.description: Allows different models within the same task.

toolsAllow.title: Allowed tools
toolsAllow.description: Real tool names JEV may assign.

jevTimeoutMs.title: JEV timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wait for JEV (up to 9000; the hook has 10 s).

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe / JEV API key
typesafeApiKey.description: JEV API key, kept in the system secure storage (Keychain on macOS). Empty: uses TYPESAFE_API_KEY or JEV_API_KEY from the environment.

priceHaiku.title: Haiku price (US$/MTok)
priceHaiku.description: input,output,cacheRead,cacheWrite in US$ per MTok (5-minute cache write). Invalid falls back to the default.

priceSonnet.title: Sonnet price (US$/MTok)
priceSonnet.description: input,output,cacheRead,cacheWrite in US$ per MTok (5-minute cache write). Invalid falls back to the default.

priceOpus.title: Opus price (US$/MTok)
priceOpus.description: input,output,cacheRead,cacheWrite in US$ per MTok (5-minute cache write). Invalid falls back to the default.

jevPricePerCall.title: Price per JEV call (US$)
jevPricePerCall.description: Added to the real cost in the status line.
